fields.System.Title: INV-902 — Rebuild the availability projection
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer during an incident, I want to regenerate the availability projection from
balances, so that drift is corrected in minutes rather than investigated for hours.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the projection is deleted, when the rebuild runs, then it is fully
  • regenerated from stock_balance.
  • - Given a correct projection, when the rebuild runs, then every row is unchanged —
  • proving the incremental update and the rebuild agree.
  • - Given the rebuild, then it can be scoped to one product or one warehouse.
  • - Given the rebuild runs while the warehouse is operating, then it does not block
  • transactions.
  • - Given this story, then it is delivered in the same iteration as
  • [INV-901](INV-901-maintain-availability-table.md).

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | product_availability, stock_balance |
| Risks | No rebuild job during an incident ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration (rebuild vs incremental agreement) |
